name: glycogen storage disease due to phosphoglycerate kinase 1 deficiency
description: Phosphoglycerate kinase (PGK) deficiency is a metabolic disorder characterized by variable combinations of nonspherocytic hemolytic anemia, myopathy, and various central nervous system abnormalities.
